title: Recovery 3.1 - boot-loader session: the seven probes
source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03 (~229 px/mm)
caption: Supply on JP5, the USB-serial adapter on J29 (its TXD through 1 kΩ), the strap from U15 pin 8 through 470 Ω onto X6, the SOP2 pad. The cable stays out of J8. Swap the two J29 signal probes if chapter 1 found hole 2 to be TX.

callouts.label: JP5 pin 1 (square), 5 V in
callouts.note: The square pad, '1' printed left of it; VIN = J8 pins 1-6 = U17's input (J-077, J-080). Bench supply + at 5.0 V, OVP 6 V, current limit 100 mA. Never above 6 V.

callouts.label: JP5 pin 2, GND
callouts.note: The round pad above pin 1, '2' printed left of it; GND, the same net as U15 pin 4 (J-080).

callouts.label: J29 hole 1: assumed chip TX
callouts.note: The bottom hole, by the printed dot (J-112). Assumed the CC3220's TX here; chapter 1 decides. If chapter 1 found hole 2 to be TX, swap the two signal probes. To the adapter's RXD.

callouts.label: J29 hole 2: assumed chip RX
callouts.note: The middle hole (J-112). Assumed the CC3220's RX here; chapter 1 decides. If chapter 1 found this hole to be TX, swap the two signal probes. The adapter's TXD through 1 kΩ.

callouts.label: J29 hole 3, GND
callouts.note: The top hole, '3' printed above it: GND (J-112). To the adapter's GND.

callouts.label: X6, the SOP2 pad
callouts.note: The bottom pad of the three right of J14 (J-098). X4 = SOP0, X5 = SOP1, X6 = SOP2 (measured with the beeper, 2026-11-05). The strap goes onto X6 only; X4 and X5 stay free.

callouts.label: U15 pin 8, 3.3 V (strap source)
callouts.note: VCC = the 3.3 V rail, on U17's output (J-110). The leg across from pin 1 (top-left of U15 in this view). The strap's source, through 470 Ω.

callouts.label: J8: cable OUT
callouts.note: The FFC stays out of J8 in every bench session: the board gets its power on JP5 only (J-077).

terminals.label: Bench supply + (5.0 V, OVP 6 V, limit 100 mA)
